explanation: That which represents truth, purity, and God's presence, in contrast to darkness which symbolizes sin and unbelief.
A state of being without God or living in sin, characterized by confusion and moral error.
Description of the good deeds and character traits a Christian should display through their life.
The concept of turning away from the truth or God's way, often associated with deceit and sinful behavior.
A state of excessive alcohol consumption leading to loss of self-control and serving as an obstacle to Christian living.
Being set apart for God, cleansed from sin and dedicated to His service; a call to live in accordance with His will.
An attitude of thankfulness toward God for all He has given, which should characterize a Christian's lifestyle.
